import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Parse blood pressure into systolic and diastolic
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Define grid
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                         hue='BMI Category', s=100, ax=ax1, style='Occupation')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 2. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Occupation
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter2 = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Daily Steps', 
                          hue='Occupation', s=100, ax=ax2, style='BMI Category')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Occupation')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax2.legend(title='Occupation', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 3. Stress Level distribution by BMI Category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
box = sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Stress Level', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_title('Stress Level Distribution by BMI Category')
ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)')

# 4. Heart Rate vs Blood Pressure
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter3 = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Systolic BP', y='Diastolic BP', 
                          size='Heart Rate', hue='Sleep Disorder', 
                          sizes=(50, 200), alpha=0.7, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Blood Pressure vs Heart Rate')
ax4.set_xlabel('Systolic Blood Pressure')
ax4.set_ylabel('Diastolic Blood Pressure')
ax4.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 5. Age distribution by Occupation
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
counts = df['Occupation'].value_counts()
bars = ax5.bar(counts.index, counts.values)
ax5.set_title('Occupation Distribution')
ax5.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom')

# 6. Correlation heatmap of numerical variables
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
heatmap = sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', 
                      cmap='coolwarm', center=0, ax=ax6, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax6.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Variables')

# 7. Sleep metrics comparison
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
occupation_groups = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean()
x = np.arange(len(occupation_groups.index))
width = 0.35

bars1 = ax7.bar(x - width/2, occupation_groups['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax7.bar(x + width/2, occupation_groups['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', alpha=0.8)

ax7.set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation')
ax7.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax7.set_ylabel('Score')
ax7.set_xticks(x)
ax7.set_xticklabels(occupation_groups.index, rotation=45)
ax7.legend()
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax7.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                f'{height:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
